info.title: Machineseeker - Listing Management API
info.description:
API endpoints and models that are needed to create, update, pause, activate, extend and delete listings.

## Getting started

1. **Generate an API token** in your user account under "Useful Functions" > "Data Import" > "Real-time API" and send it as a `Bearer` token in the `Authorization` header (see Authentication below).
2. **Look up the reference data** you need for a listing: the category tree (`GET /json/category/tree`), the available product types (`GET /json/product/types`) and their properties (`GET /json/product/properties`).
3. **Upload images and documents first.** Files have to be uploaded via `POST /json/listing-asset/image` and `POST /json/listing-asset/document` *before* they can be attached to a listing. Each upload returns a temporary file name.
4. **Create or update the listing** via `POST` / `PUT /json/listing` and reference the temporary file names from step 3 in the `images` and `docs` fields.
5. **Manage the listing** afterwards: pause, activate, extend or delete it via the corresponding endpoints.

## Versioning

Starting with this release the version follows a date-based scheme (`YY.M.PATCH`, e.g. `26.7.0` = July 2026). The previous scheme was semantic (last version was `2.0.1`). The jump in the version number does **not** indicate breaking changes.

get.description: Get the available product types. Pass the "name" of the product type to "productType" in the create request. Categories and product types have an n:m relationship: a single product type can belong to several categories and a category can offer several product types. Use the optional categoryId parameter to restrict the result to the product types available in a specific category.

auth-header.name: Authorization
auth-header.description: Authorize API requests with this header field. The token can be generated in the user account under "Useful Functions" > "Data Import" > "Real-time API": https://www.machineseeker.com/import/auto/api-token or https://www.truckscout24.com/import/auto/api-token

content-header.name: Content-Type
content-header.description: Request content is always provided in JSON syntax.

language-header.name: Accept-Language
language-header.description: The Accept-Language header should be in the format LL-CC, where LL is a two-letter lowercase language code according to ISO-639-1 and CC is a two-letter lowercase country code according to ISO-3166-1 alpha-2. E.g. "en-us", "en-gb" or "de-de". If Accept-Language is not set, then "en-us" is used by default. If Accept-Language is set but the country code CC in <LL-CC> is not valid, then a default country for language LL is chosen. If the language code is not valid, then "en-us" is used by default. If the country does not matter, it is also possible to just pass the language, e.g. "es". A default country is chosen in this case.
